title: Auto-check your reviews
subtitle: Let a high accuracy rescan accept the cards that were right

steps.intro: Cards the scanner wasn't sure about wait for review.
steps.openReview: Open the review grid to see them all at once.
steps.startAutoCheck: Press Auto-check to rescan their photos with high accuracy.
steps.checking: Cards are checked in small batches.
steps.results: Matches are accepted for you. Anything else stays with a note on what to look at.
steps.pause: Pause any time. Cards being checked finish first.
steps.resume: Resume later to pick up where you left off.
